evidence_summary: Count with is_empty filter returns exact=40 vs inexact=24; discrepancy likely due to index not fully synchronized after insertion with indexing_threshold=1
rationale: The count discrepancy (40 vs 24) occurs because the collection was configured with indexing_threshold=1 but 200 points were inserted; the inexact (segment statistics) count reflects indexed state while exact count reflects full scan - this is expected behavior during indexing, not a defect
